How to Play
GOAL: Pick up every stick on the board and feed it to the hole. Clear the board to reach the next level. There are 15 themed levels; rack up the highest score.
🎲 HOW A TURN WORKS
  1. Roll the die. You get 0–5 actions (a normal die, but 0 instead of 6).
  2. Spend every action before you can roll again. Each step on the grid costs 1, and each pick-up or drop costs 1.
  3. Pick up sticks by standing on one and pressing Pick/Drop. You can carry 3 at first, and more on later levels (up to 6).
  4. Feed the hole: stand on the hole and press Pick/Drop to drop in everything you carry for points.
Rolled a 0? Carrying sticks: you drop them and they scatter. Empty-handed: the hole spits out a stick nearby. Standing on the hole: bonus points!
🕹️ CONTROLS
Use the mouse (or touch), the keyboard, or a USB controller / arcade stick, and mix them freely. Plug a controller in and press any button once; CONTROLLER CONNECTED appears on the board.

How to PlayInfo button—SELECT
On a controller, the stick scrolls this screen and any button closes it. Any button also starts the game from the name screen. Button 1 or START plays again after Game Over.
🎁 GOOD THINGS TO FIND
  • Bonus Sticks Sticks with a soft yellow glow. Picking one doubles your remaining actions. When your actions run out you get a Bonus Roll (two dice, 2–12) and deposits are worth 2×. Roll 12 to bonus again.
  • Secret Life Tile One hidden square per level. Drop a stick on it for +1 life (or +10 points if you already have 5). It pulses when you stand on it carrying sticks.
  • Power Sticks Rare. Speed: next 10 moves are free. Shield: 30 seconds safe from hazards. Vision: shows the Secret Life Tile for 30 seconds.
  • Mystery Tree Pops up now and then. Stand on it and press Pick/Drop: carrying sticks, feed it one for +1 life (+10 points at 5 lives); empty-handed, get a full load of sticks. Then it vanishes.
⚠️ DANGERS
  • Hazards Every level adds its own: fire, ice, snakes, sharks, spiders, shadow monsters and more. Watch the Activity log for a tip when a level starts.
  • Stick Monster Some sticks are secretly cursed. Picking one starts a battle: roll 2–5 to win (and keep a powered-up stick), 0–1 to lose a life. Win streaks multiply stick value: 2× for wins 1–3, 3× on win 4, 4× on win 5, rising to 8× at 9+. Three wins in a row also earns +1 life. A loss resets the streak.
